title: Music and musical instruments
about: Words for music: music, musical and musician, the names of instruments and the people who play them. You also learn to talk about the kinds of music you love or can't stand.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Music — незлічуване слово: не musics і не a music. Музичний інструмент — a musical instrument. Band (гурт) і concert (концерт) уже означають музику, тому слово music перед ними не потрібне. Грати на інструменті — play the guitar, без on. Слухати музику — listen to music, з to.

rows: She plays in a music band.
We're going to a music concert.

items.pattern: music (uncountable) · some music · a lot of music
items.meaning: the sounds people make with their voices or instruments, nice to listen to
items.example: There was great **music** at the school party.
more: What kind of **music** do you like?
I can't do my homework with loud **music** on.
items.watchOut: Music незлічуване: не musics і не a music. Кажуть some music, a lot of music, а про одну пісню — a song.

items.meaning: about music; good at music
items.example: My cousin has got three **musical** instruments in her bedroom.
more: Tom is very **musical**. He can play a song after he hears it once.
Which **musical** instrument is the easiest to learn?
items.watchOut: Музичний інструмент — a musical instrument, а не a music instrument. Але в інших словах часто стоїть music: a music lesson, a music teacher, a music shop.

items.meaning: a person who plays music, often as a job
items.example: My uncle is a **musician**. He plays the guitar at parties and festivals.
more: There were six **musicians** on the stage.
She wants to be a **musician** when she grows up.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: mu-SI-cian. Musician — людина, musical — прикметник, music — сама музика.

items.meaning: a big instrument with black and white keys
items.example: We've got an old **piano** in our living room.
more: Grandma sits at the **piano** after dinner every Christmas.
Our music teacher sits at the **piano** in every lesson.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: pi-A-no. Piano — і фортепіано, і піаніно; рояль — a grand piano, але часто теж просто piano.

items.meaning: a big instrument with four strings; you sit and hold it between your knees
items.example: The **cello** is too big to take on the bus.
more: My friend plays the **cello** in the school orchestra.
I love the low, soft sound of the **cello**.
items.watchOut: Перша буква читається як «ч»: /ˈtʃeləʊ/, а не «целло».

items.pattern: the guitar · play the guitar · an electric guitar
items.meaning: an instrument with six strings; you play it with your fingers
items.example: Dad took his **guitar** on our camping trip.
more: I want an electric **guitar** for my birthday.
Can you teach me three songs on the **guitar**?
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: gi-TAR. Літера u не читається.

items.meaning: a long thin metal instrument; you hold it to the side and blow across it
items.example: Lena keeps her **flute** in a small black box.
more: The **flute** has a soft, sweet sound.
Which is harder to play: the **flute** or the violin?

items.meaning: a small instrument with four strings; you hold it under your chin
items.example: Sofia practises the **violin** for an hour every day.
more: My **violin** was a present from my grandad.
You play the **violin** with a long stick called a bow.
items.watchOut: Наголос на останньому складі: vio-LIN.

items.meaning: a metal instrument; you blow into it and it makes a loud, bright sound
items.example: My neighbour plays the **trumpet** and the whole street can hear it!
more: His new **trumpet** is shiny and gold.
You blow into a **trumpet** and press three buttons.
items.watchOut: Музична труба — trumpet. Труба для води чи газу — pipe.

items.meaning: a long black instrument; you blow into it and hold it in front of you
items.example: Mark found an old **clarinet** in his grandparents' house.
more: The **clarinet** is black with silver keys.
I can play two songs on the **clarinet** now.
items.watchOut: Наголос на останньому складі: cla-ri-NET.

items.pattern: the drums · play the drums · a drum
items.meaning: instruments you hit with sticks
items.example: Leo got **drums** for his birthday, and now the house is very noisy.
more: She plays the **drums** in a rock band.
The children made a **drum** from an old box.
items.watchOut: Ударна установка — the drums (множина): He plays the drums. Один барабан — a drum.

items.pattern: play the piano / the guitar / the drums
items.meaning: make music with an instrument
items.example: My sister **plays the guitar** in the evenings.
more: Can your dad **play the piano**?
Kids in our school can **play the drums** in the music room.
items.watchOut: Грати НА гітарі — play the guitar, без on. Перед інструментом зазвичай the. Порівняй зі спортом: play football — без the.

items.pattern: be learning the guitar / the violin
items.meaning: have lessons and practise so that you can play it
items.example: Max **is learning the guitar**. He knows four songs already.
more: I'd like to **learn the drums** next year.
My mum **is learning the piano** with an app on her phone.
items.watchOut: «Вчуся грати на гітарі» — I'm learning the guitar або I'm learning to play the guitar. Без on.

items.meaning: learn with a teacher, usually every week
items.uk: займатися фортепіано (з учителем), ходити на уроки фортепіано
items.example: Anna **has piano lessons** on Mondays and Thursdays.
more: I **had guitar lessons** when I was ten.
Do you want to **have drum lessons** this summer?
items.watchOut: Кажуть have (або take) piano lessons. Назва інструменту тут без the: piano lessons, не the piano lessons.

items.meaning: a person who plays that instrument
items.example: The **flute-player** in our school band is only eleven.
more: We need a **trumpet-player** for the summer concert.
My uncle is a **guitar-player** in a jazz band.
items.watchOut: Можна писати з дефісом або окремо: a flute-player / a flute player. Для барабанів частіше кажуть drummer.

items.pattern: play in an orchestra · a school / city orchestra
items.meaning: play music in a big group of musicians, usually classical music
items.example: My cousin **plays in an orchestra** in Kyiv.
more: Our school **orchestra** has twenty violins.
I want to **play in an orchestra** one day.
items.watchOut: Вимова: ch тут як «к»: /ˈɔːkɪstrə/. Кажуть play in an orchestra — з in.

items.meaning: a person who plays the violin
items.example: The young **violinist** played a beautiful song at the end of the concert.
more: My grandma was a **violinist** in a theatre.
Two **violinists** played at the opening of the new library.
items.watchOut: Наголос: vio-LIN-ist. Можна сказати і a violin player.

items.meaning: a person who plays the piano
items.example: The **pianist** at the hotel plays every evening at dinner.
more: She practises five hours a day because she wants to be a **pianist**.
Our school has a new music teacher. He's a great **pianist**.
items.watchOut: У британській вимові наголос на першому складі: PI-a-nist. Можна сказати і a piano player.

items.meaning: serious music by composers like Mozart and Beethoven
items.example: My grandad listens to **classical music** when he reads.
more: We heard some **classical music** at the museum.
Does **classical music** help you study?
items.watchOut: Класична музика — classical music, не classic music. Classic означає «відомий, улюблений багатьма»: a classic film.

items.meaning: really don't like something
items.example: My best friend **can't stand** jazz. She says it's boring.
more: I **can't stand** waiting for the bus in the rain.
Mum **can't stand** loud music in the car.
items.watchOut: Вживається майже завжди в запереченні: I can't stand… Не плутай з can't stay — «не можу залишитися».

items.pattern: opera · an opera · go to the opera
items.meaning: a kind of play where people sing all the words
items.example: We saw our first **opera** on a school trip.
more: My aunt sings in the **opera** in Odesa.
Some people love **opera**, but I find it too long.
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: O-pe-ra.

items.pattern: pop · pop music · a pop song / singer
items.meaning: modern popular music with easy songs
items.example: My friends and I like **pop music** best.
more: She sings a **pop** song at every family party.
The radio in the shop plays **pop music** all day.

items.meaning: old traditional music of a country
items.example: At the village festival, a band played Ukrainian **folk music**.
more: My grandma knows a lot of **folk songs**.
**Folk music** often tells stories about everyday life.
items.watchOut: Народна музика — folk music, не national music. Літера l у folk не вимовляється: /fəʊk/.

items.meaning: music from the USA, often with trumpet, piano and drums; musicians often make up the music as they play
items.example: There's a **jazz** band in the park every Sunday in summer.
more: My dad plays **jazz** on the piano.
Do you like **jazz** or do you prefer rock?

items.pattern: rock · rock music · a rock band
items.meaning: loud music with electric guitars and drums
items.example: My older brother listens to **rock** in his room all day.
more: We went to a **rock** concert in the summer.
Dad played in a **rock** band when he was young.

items.pattern: listen to music / the radio / a song
items.meaning: hear music and pay attention to it
items.example: I always **listen to music** when I tidy my room.
more: Let's **listen to** this song again!
My dog falls asleep when we **listen to music**.
items.watchOut: Слухати музику — listen TO music. Без to не можна, коли далі йде те, що слухаєш: не listen music.

items.meaning: copy music from the internet onto your phone or computer
items.example: I **downloaded some songs** for the long car journey.
more: Can you **download** this album for me?
She **downloads** new music every Friday.

items.pattern: a band · play in a band · a rock / jazz band
items.meaning: a group of musicians who play together (pop, rock or jazz)
items.example: My cousin plays the drums in a **band** with her friends.
more: What's your favourite **band**?
The **band** played at the end of the school year.
items.watchOut: Не кажуть a music band: band уже означає музичний гурт.

items.pattern: a concert · go to a concert · at a concert
items.meaning: an event where musicians play for people
items.example: Our class is going to a **concert** at the town hall.
more: The **concert** was so good that we didn't want to go home.
I saw my teacher at the **concert** last night.
items.watchOut: Не a music concert: concert завжди про музику. «На концерті» — at a concert, не on a concert.

warmup.explain: Грати на інструменті — play the drums, без on.
Терпіти не можу — can't stand. Can't stay — «не можу залишитися».

warmup.q: Have you got any ___ instruments at home?

warmup.q: We're going to a ___ on Saturday.
warmup.explain: Concert уже означає музику, music додавати не треба.
Грати в оркестрі — play in an orchestra.
Людина, яка грає музику, — a musician.

C.explain: Той, хто грає на скрипці, — violinist.

C.q: Sofia plays the piano very well. She's a good ___.
C.explain: Той, хто грає на фортепіано, — pianist.

C.q: I ___ the drums in my school band.
C.explain: Грати на інструменті — play the drums, без on.

D.q: Grandad loves ___ music: Mozart, Bach and Beethoven.
D.explain: Моцарт і Бетховен — це classical music.

D.q: I really hate opera. I ___ it.

example.title: Music in my family
example.uk:
Минулого року я почала вчитися грати на скрипці. Щосереди в мене уроки. Моя вчителька — чудова скрипалька. Вона грає в оркестрі нашого міста.

Мій брат грає на барабанах у рок-гурті. Я терпіти не можу їхніх гучних пісень! Мені більше подобається класична музика.

У суботу ми ходили на концерт. Відомий піаніст грав Моцарта. Дорогою додому я знову слухала цю музику в телефоні. Тепер я теж хочу стати музиканткою!
example.en:
Last year I started [[learning the violin|c2]]. I [[have lessons|c3]] every Wednesday. My teacher is a great [[violinist|c6]]. She [[plays in an orchestra|c5]] in our city.

My brother [[plays the drums|c1]] in a [[rock|d7]] [[band|d10]]. I [[can't stand|d2]] their loud songs! I prefer [[classical music|d1]].

On Saturday we went to a [[concert|d11]]. A famous [[pianist|c7]] played Mozart. On the way home, I [[listened to|d8]] the music again on my phone. Now I want to be a [[musician|a3]] too!
